title: 1,750 In 5 Minutes! BEST New RAID Farm in Minecraft 1.21+
description: In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to build a new style raid farm that takes advantage of an updated pathfinding mechanic to keep raids flowing smoothly with minimal downtime. The design uses a dual-core chamber that forces raid mobs to drop instantly, which helps end raids around 50% faster and boosts overall efficiency by up to 20%. The result is a raid farm that’s built to be fast, simple, and cheap, making it one of the strongest options you can build in Minecraft right now.
